The '''Dekk-6 power coupling''' was a top-of-the-line [[Power coupling/Legends|power coupling]] which was produced under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] highly coveted this component for use in the ''[[Manka Hunter]]''.
